QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_74

question.text: As the IM of an open-ended Cat III AIF, you must choose between two performance-fee crystallisation frequencies proposed by LPs: (a) monthly crystallisation (b) annual crystallisation with HWM. Which is PREFERABLE from an alignment-of-interest perspective?

answer.text: Monthly — immediate reward for monthly performance
Annual with HWM — avoids rewarding monthly lucky streaks that reverse, and enforces HWM discipline

explanation.text: The Logic: Monthly crystallisation rewards lucky streaks that may reverse within weeks. Annual with HWM aligns IM incentives with sustained performance and prevents reward for volatility mistaken for skill. This is why 3-year cycle or fund-end crystallisation is industry-preferred. The Trap: Option A misaligns incentives. Option B is wrong. Option D is a weaker version of B. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-B for crystallisation; X-A/B for IA. Manager's Pro-Tip: Even with annual HWM crystallisation, DAILY ACCRUAL of performance fee in NAV is best practice — ensures subscription/redemption at the correct NAV. Paying annually but accruing daily is the gold standard.
